question: Which of the following Indian personalities holds the honour of being the first-ever Indian to perform in the prestigious Royal Albert Hall, London?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar **was the first Indian artist to perform live at **London’s iconic Royal Albert Hall in 1974.**
 
• She was a** legendary singer,** who passed away **aged 92 in Mumbai on 6 Feb 2022.**
 
• **Famous Song:** **Ae Mere Wattan Ke Logo** (Written by **Kavi Pradeep** and sang on Republic Day **26 January 1963**), **Aisa Des Hai Mera** (Veer-Zaara), **Aaja Re Pardesi** (Madhumati),** Inhin Logon Ne** (Pakeezah), **Aayega Aanewala** (Mahal), etc.
 
• She has received **India's highest civilian honour Bharat Ratna (2001), Padma Vibhushan (1999), Dadasaheb Phalke Award (1989), etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dilip Kumar **is a veteran Indian actor and his real name is Muhammed Yusuf Khan.
 
• **Jagjit Singh** was an Indian composer, singer, and musician.
 
 
• He is also known as "The Ghazal King" or "King of Ghazals" in Indian music.
 
 
 
• **Amitabh Bachchan** is an Indian actor, film producer, television host, and former politician.
